fields.statement: At e5443c542, go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run SessionDone -count=1 passes (TestSessionDoneReviewRecords: check session refused naming `rhiza run findings` until a round is journaled for its check and cycle; critic refused naming `rhiza run verdict` while a blocker/major is unjudged, also with only the major left, and succeeds once both have verdicts; fixer never refused). The plan reviewer case (TestReviewVisitNeedsRound) and TestReviewCheckFindingsFlag pass too. The committed test journals a non-empty round, and its refusal assertion checks the message rather than the error code, so I ran a scratch probe test in a copy outside the repo. In it the refusal is CodeConflict, a check session succeeds after an empty {"findings":[]} round, and a critic with one unjudged blocker is refused, then succeeds after its verdict. Read the diff: session_done.go calls reviewRecordMissing only for role check/critic sessions with a run and a check, and skips when the run is ended or the step moved on.
